result.title: DiffAnchor: Anchor-Space Diffusion for Monocular 3D Hand Pose Estimation
result.comment: 10 pages. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Embodied AI
result.summary: Accurate and efficient monocular 3D hand pose estimation is an important perception capability for embodied human interaction and dexterous manipulation. Recent diffusion-based methods model pose uncertainty by iteratively denoising 3D joint coordinates. However, directly diffusing the final joints requires the generative process to simultaneously explore plausible poses and recover precise coordinates, often relying on additional denoising steps or multiple hypotheses and consequently increasing inference cost. In this work, we propose DiffAnchor, a few-step anchor-space diffusion framework that diffuses anchors rather than joints. Our key insight is that stochastic exploration does not need to operate directly on the final output. Instead, diffusion searches for informative intermediate anchors that serve as local 3D regressors, while anchor-to-joint offset prediction and weighted aggregation complete precise joint localization. Specifically, fixed context anchors provide stable global references, whereas noisy dynamic anchors are iteratively refined toward informative joint regions. An importance-guided anchor selection and replenishment mechanism further retains useful anchors, removes ineffective ones, and explores insufficiently covered regions. This design reduces the precision burden of the diffusion process and enables accurate prediction using only a few denoising steps and a single hypothesis. Extensive experiments on HO-3D V2, NYU, ICVL, and InterHand2.6M demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on the first three benchmarks and competitive performance on challenging interacting-hand estimation, while maintaining inference efficiency comparable to deterministic regression baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DiffAnchor，在单目 3D 手部姿态估计中把扩散过程放在中间 anchor 空间而非最终关节坐标上，由固定上下文锚点与动态锚点迭代细化，再经 anchor-to-joint 偏移预测和加权聚合输出精确关节，辅以重要性引导的锚点筛选与补充，实现少步去噪、单假设的高效预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 「随机搜索不直接作用于最终输出、而在中间表示上完成再由读出模块精确化」这一思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 工作区的状态更新、少步迭代与计算分配提供可核查的方法线索，但本文任务为纯视觉姿态估计，与多模态推理无直接联系。
